title: Cached cactus sorting
purpose: Sort rows from cached sizes, then columns, and harvest the complete field.
start: Any ordinary square field; keep enough pumpkins for the missing cacti. Mega Farm is optional.

title: Cactus bubble sort
purpose: Readable adjacent-swap alternative with an early finish after the last inversion.
start: Any ordinary square field; keep enough pumpkins for the missing cacti. Mega Farm is optional.

title: Mapped maze with waiting stations
purpose: Map a fresh maze, assign treasure regions, and reuse it up to 300 times.
start: Ordinary farm or a full-field maze. Supply Weird Substance; run no other substance consumer at the same time. Mega Farm is optional.

title: Dinosaur with early shortcuts
purpose: Use early shortcuts on even fields, then switch to a simple full-field cycle.
start: At least 2×2 and enough cactus for apples. Clears the farm for every new tail; odd sizes use short serpentine runs.

title: Conservative dinosaur cycle
purpose: Follow a fixed Hamiltonian cycle on even fields without shortcut bookkeeping or lists.
start: At least 2×2 and enough cactus for apples. Clears the farm for every new tail; odd sizes use short serpentine runs.
